strings.zh: 几天前这里被火箭队的人给袭击了,{NEWLINE}他们还来精灵中心大翻特翻,{CLEAR}不知道是在找什么。
strings.en: A few days ago, Team Rocket attacked{NEWLINE}this place.{SCROLL}They even turned the Pokémon Center{NEWLINE}upside down looking for something.

strings.zh: 仔细想想火箭队来这里{NEWLINE}一定是为了抢夺什么宝物。{SCROLL}而富士老人被火箭队抓走,{NEWLINE}是不是就说明富士老人家里{CLEAR}有火箭队都非常重视的宝物呢？
strings.en: Come to think of it, Team Rocket must{NEWLINE}have come to steal some treasure.{SCROLL}And they kidnapped Mr. Fuji... Doesn’t{NEWLINE}that mean Mr. Fuji has a treasure at his{CLEAR}place that Team Rocket really wants?

strings.zh: 从10号路北边走水路,{NEWLINE}可以到达一个老旧的发电站哦。{CLEAR}据说有人在那里看到过{CLEAR}闪着金黄色光芒的大鸟。
strings.en: Take the waterway north of Route 10,{NEWLINE}and you can reach an old power plant.{SCROLL}They say someone saw a big bird there,{NEWLINE}shining with a golden light.

strings.zh: 发电站修好后,{NEWLINE}电台广播能够正常播放了。{CLEAR}局长很是高兴啊。
strings.en: The Director of the Radio Station{NEWLINE}sure was happy.{SCROLL}He said they’re back on the air,{NEWLINE}because the Power Plant is running{CLEAR}smoothly again.

strings.zh: 火箭队那伙人{NEWLINE}来到紫苑镇的时候杀气腾腾的,{CLEAR}简直就像要吃人的魔鬼。
strings.en: When Team Rocket came to Lavender{NEWLINE}Town, they were out for blood. They{CLEAR}were like man-eating demons.

strings.zh: 感谢这片土地上{NEWLINE}有精灵联盟这样强大的管理机构,{CLEAR}不然我们可要被火箭队给害惨了。
strings.en: I’m grateful this land has a powerful{NEWLINE}governing body like the Pokémon League.{CLEAR}Otherwise, Team Rocket would have made{CLEAR}us really suffer.

strings.zh: 你是在各地旅行的训练家吧？{SCROLL}这座镇上有一位{NEWLINE}对口袋妖怪很有研究的富士老先生,{CLEAR}非常值得去拜访一下哦。
strings.en: You’re a Trainer traveling around,{NEWLINE}aren’t you?{SCROLL}Old Mr. Fuji here in town knows a lot{NEWLINE}about Pokémon. He’s well worth a visit.

strings.zh: 听说最近精灵之塔上会出现幽灵呢。
strings.en: I heard ghosts have been appearing in{NEWLINE}Pokémon Tower lately.

strings.zh: 我也听说了,好多人都目击了呢。
strings.en: I heard that too. Lots of people have{NEWLINE}seen them.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这种只是传闻吧,{NEWLINE}能有多少可信度啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That’s just a rumor, isn’t it?{NEWLINE}How much of it can be true?

strings.zh: 我虽然没有看见,{NEWLINE}但是大家都这么说。
strings.en: I haven’t seen one myself, but that’s{NEWLINE}what everyone says.
So, do you think there are ghosts?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『呃……不,{NEWLINE}我觉得不会有的,大概吧……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Uh... No, I don’t think there{NEWLINE}are. Probably...

strings.zh: 哈哈,也是啊。{NEWLINE}你左肩上放着一只白色的手什么的{CLEAR}肯定是我看错了。
strings.en: Ha ha, right. That white hand resting on{NEWLINE}your left shoulder must just be my eyes{CLEAR}playing tricks.
{VAR:0103:0}: Come on, don’t joke around{NEWLINE}like that...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这个其实已经知道了,{NEWLINE}是火箭队搞的鬼。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Actually, we already know. It{NEWLINE}was Team Rocket all along.

strings.zh: 这里是口袋妖怪们死后安息的小镇,{NEWLINE}所以显得有点阴森呢。
strings.en: Pokémon come to rest in this town after{NEWLINE}they pass away. That’s why it feels a{CLEAR}bit gloomy.

strings.zh: 所以说传闻还是有一定可信度的。
strings.en: So the rumors had some truth to them{NEWLINE}after all.
